firm_data.firm_description: Cyrus D. Mehta & Partners PLLC represents corporate and individual clients in complex and routine immigration law matters. The firm has developed expertise in representing large corporations regarding their immigration needs as well as representing individuals in business and family immigration, citizenship, removal or asylum matters.
notable_facts: Chambers USA 2024 states the firm is '[r]enowned for its capacity to offer counsel on highly complex immigration cases...'
The firm is committed to providing exceptional services to its clients, often under complex and novel circumstances, whether the client is a corporation or an individual.
The firm’s attorneys are regularly invited to speak at legal seminars and conduct workshops for bar associations, non-profit organizations and universities.

email.subject: AI for immigration law, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Cyrus,

Chambers USA recognized your firm's capacity to offer counsel on highly complex immigration cases. That kind of sophistication demands tools that match your standards, not compromise them.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters to boutique practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on complex matters.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
